title: Emoji Panel
description: EmojiPanel is a plugin for Paper servers that provides an interactive GUI palette for players to easily select and insert Unicode emojis into their chat.
body:
## Features
*   **Interactive GUI:** A fully organized 54-slot menu containing a curated collection of 54 unique emojis.
*   **Easy Insertion:** Left-click an emoji in the menu to suggest it in your chat bar. 

## Commands
*   `/emojipanel` - Opens the interactive emoji selection menu.

## How to Use
1.  Run the `/emojipanel` command.
2.  Browse the menu to find the emoji you want to use.
3.  Click the desired emoji.
4.  A message will appear in your chat. Left-click the message to put the emoji into your chat bar, or **Shift+Click** the message to instantly insert it at your current cursor position.
